title: Pico + NeoPixel prototype tray
brief: An open, dimensioned tray and a provisional 5 V electrical prototype for a Raspberry Pi Pico Rev3 and Adafruit NeoPixel Stick #1426.
summary: Two-board tray checked against maker STEP models. Proposed 5 V power splits through two separate WAGO 221-415 connectors into Pico USB, Stick and an off-tray Perma-Proto shifter board. Port labels are assembly assignments; branch ratings, exact board holes, loads and measurements remain open.

parts.name: Raspberry Pi Pico Rev3
parts.detail: Official STEP envelope including micro-USB overhang: 52.3 × 21.0 × 3.73 mm. Board specification says 51 × 21 × 1 mm PCB. Four 2.1 mm mounting holes. No physical board was measured.
parts.voltage: USB 5 V input; board logic 3.3 V

parts.name: Adafruit NeoPixel Stick #1426, 8 RGB pixels
parts.detail: Manufacturer product page gives 51.1 × 10.22 × 3.19 mm; manufacturer STEP measures 50.8 × 10.16 × 2.6 mm. Tray check uses published X/Y and rounded-up 3.2 mm Z. Eight RGB pixels can draw up to 480 mA total at full white by Adafruit's 60 mA/pixel estimate. Exact shipped LED revision and real draw need checking.
parts.voltage: 5 V nominal; confirm exact product revision

parts.name: Original two-board prototype tray
parts.detail: Editable OpenCascade source and STEP are in examples/pico-neopixel-tray. Open tray with six locator pins and a USB-side notch. Not released for fabrication until cable, fastening, tolerance and print-process checks pass.

parts.name: TI SN74AHCT125N, PDIP-14
parts.detail: Use gate 1: Pico GP2 to 1A pin 2, 1Y pin 3 to series resistor, 1OE pin 1 low. VCC pin 14, GND pin 7. Proposed unused gates: 2OE/3OE/4OE and 2A/3A/4A tied to VCC; outputs unconnected, per TI layout example. Exact board/breadboard mounting and power-up behavior are not verified in tray CAD.

parts.name: 470 Ω series data resistor
parts.detail: Place close to Stick DIN, between 74AHCT125 gate-1 output and DIN. Choose a real resistor and verify its value. Not located in tray CAD.

parts.name: 1000 µF polarized capacitor, at least 6.3 V
parts.detail: Proposed symbolic +/− terminals across Stick 5VDC/GND at its input; check actual purchased capacitor markings, polarity, voltage rating and dimensions. Not located in tray CAD.

parts.name: 0.1 µF ceramic bypass capacitor
parts.detail: Across SN74AHCT125N VCC pin 14 and GND pin 7, close to the IC per TI. Not located in tray CAD.

parts.name: Adafruit #276 regulated 5 V / 2 A wall supply (proposed)
parts.detail: UL-listed 5 V, up to 2 A positive-tip 5.5/2.1 mm barrel output per maker listing. This is a proposed exact source, not an assembled/bench-verified supply. Connector, branch and load checks remain open.

parts.name: Adafruit #368 2.1 mm female barrel to screw terminal (proposed)
parts.detail: Accepts positive-tip 5.5/2.1 mm plug and exposes marked +/− terminals. Vendor support cites nominal 2 A, but verify actual unit, wire retention and heating. The two screws do not establish a safe three-way branch; distribution hardware is separate and unresolved. Off-tray.

parts.name: WAGO 221-415 five-conductor splice, +5 V (proposed)
parts.detail: One +5 V common splice. Project-assigned ports 1–4: #368 feed, Pico USB, Stick, Perma-Proto. Port 5 unused. Port labels are assembly positions, not manufacturer-printed terminal numbers. WAGO lists five conductor positions and 24–12 AWG; do not infer a 22 AWG assembly current rating from a larger-wire connector rating. External to tray CAD.

parts.name: WAGO 221-415 five-conductor splice, GND (proposed)
parts.detail: Separate common ground splice. Project-assigned ports 1–4: #368 return, Pico USB, Stick, Perma-Proto. Port 5 unused. Port labels are assembly positions only. Keep the +5 V connector physically separate and unmistakably marked. External to tray CAD.

parts.name: Adafruit Perma-Proto half-size PCB #1609 (proposed)
parts.detail: Off-tray 51 × 81 mm soldered carrier for SN74AHCT125N and its local 5 V/GND ties. Maker lists four marked power rails, not an assembled rail current rating. The project +/− bus labels are net names, not exact hole addresses; map and continuity-check individual holes before soldering. Do not route the LED or Pico USB branch through this board.

parts.name: Adafruit #288 red 22 AWG solid insulated wire (proposed)
parts.detail: 25 ft spool proposed for stationary +5 V branch conductors. WAGO 221-415 and #3972 gauge ranges include 22 AWG. Actual cut lengths, #368 clamp fit, 22 AWG branch ampacity, voltage drop, solder termination and strain relief still need review.

parts.name: Adafruit #290 black 22 AWG solid insulated wire (proposed)
parts.detail: 25 ft spool proposed for stationary ground branch conductors. Mark polarity, measure cut lengths, check retention/ampacity/voltage drop and add strain relief. Do not treat wire color as a substitute for a meter check.

parts.name: Adafruit #3972 Micro-B male terminal adapter (proposed)
parts.detail: Terminal A is USB pin 1 V+; E is pin 5 GND. B/C/D are left disconnected in this power-only proposal. Listed adapter size 32.5 × 28.0 × 10.4 mm and 26–16 AWG terminal wire range; no assembly current rating was established. Must remain off-tray until plug/cable fit and strain relief are checked.

steps.title: Confirm source model revisions
steps.detail: Download the Raspberry Pi and Adafruit STEP files named in the example README and compare their hashes with the fit report.

steps.title: Check mechanical dimensions
steps.detail: Run the verification script, then measure the exact boards and connector on physical samples before committing to a print.

steps.title: Verify the proposed source and rate every branch
steps.detail: Adafruit #276 lists 5 V / 2 A. Confirm polarity and current capability on the purchased source, #368, both WAGO 221-415 splices, 22 AWG wire, #3972 and the soldered Perma-Proto rail. Check the assigned one-feed/three-branch port map; no two conductors share a WAGO clamp. Source or measure Pico and AHCT peak current before accepting margin.

steps.title: Assemble the off-tray data interface
steps.detail: With power disconnected, place the SN74AHCT125N on the #1609 carrier. Feed one +5 V/GND pair to its assigned rails, then use distinct soldered holes for VCC/GND, 1OE low and six unused OE/A inputs high. Wire Pico GP2 to 1A, 1Y through 470 Ω to Stick DIN, and bypass VCC/GND. Map exact holes and check both rail continuity and purchased PDIP pin numbering before power.

steps.title: Connect power and common ground
steps.detail: With power disconnected, connect #276 through #368 to two separate WAGO 221-415 splices. For each splice assign port 1 to the source, 2 to Pico #3972, 3 to Stick and 4 to the off-tray #1609 shifter board; leave port 5 empty. Use proposed red/black 22 AWG wire only after checking every clamp, branch rating and strain relief. Verify polarity, continuity, isolation and absence of a second USB source.

steps.title: Bench test before tray assembly
steps.detail: After unpowered polarity/continuity checks, bring up with a current limit and low brightness. Measure worst-case total and branch currents, rail sag at the Stick and IC, and data levels. Stop if source, connector, cable or junction limits are exceeded.

steps.title: Print a fit coupon
steps.detail: Use the intended material and printer to test locator-pin diameter, wall thickness and board-hole engagement before printing the full tray.

steps.title: Dry-fit unpowered parts
steps.detail: Check board insertion and removal, USB plug access, cable bend, wire clearance and retention without connecting power.

steps.title: Package the auxiliary electronics
steps.detail: Measure both WAGO 221-415 connectors, the 51 × 81 mm #1609 board, #368, #3972, IC, capacitors, resistor and cut harness. These parts remain off the verified tray; provide insulation and strain relief, then revise CAD if enclosing them.

notes: The per-conductor register uses two separate WAGO 221-415 five-position common splices, one +5 V and one GND. Port numbers 1–5 are project assignments, not manufacturer terminal markings. Each uses four positions: source, Pico USB, Stick, and an off-tray Perma-Proto #1609 shifter board; position 5 is unused. The board +/− labels represent selected rail nets, not mapped solder holes. Exact holes, conductor lengths, 22 AWG current/voltage-drop limits, clamp performance, #3972 assembly rating and physical fit remain open. Mated source/USB contact rows are electrical continuity paths, not loose wires. Pico USB socket contacts, resistor and bypass leads remain unnamed. CAD fit covers only Pico and Stick. Power worksheet remains incomplete pending Pico/AHCT load values and bench checks.

mechanicalConnections.label: Four tray locator pins enter Pico mounting holes
mechanicalConnections.note: CAD nominal: 1.6 mm pins in 2.1 mm holes, 0.25 mm radial clearance; four hole centers from the official Pico STEP. They locate the board but do not retain it. Physical print and purchased-board fit remain untested.

mechanicalConnections.label: Two tray locator pins enter Stick mounting holes
mechanicalConnections.note: CAD nominal: 1.6 mm pins in 2.2 mm holes, 0.30 mm radial clearance. Manufacturer STEP and published dimensions were compared; purchased Stick revision, insertion and retention remain untested.
